notes.title: Horror Story: Hallowseed - patch 003
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38082864/6bcdcb80b992367e378f3d32f9b5c55334093987.jpg

Greetings 

Today we bring you patch 003 for Horror Story: Hallowseed. This update brings in new systems to help players avoid demons and find items, along with a slight alteration for some of the save points and a fix for the blackscreen issue, some of the players were experiencing. Due to the nature of this issue all save files will be deleted after you update to the latest version. We apologize for this inconvenience, however it is necessary to ensure proper functionality of this fix.

Read the full changelog below:

 Added "Demonic Sense": Player will start to feel bad or the phone will start emitting static noise, when getting closer to the demon, even before the chase starts
 Added several new hints to help players to find the hidden items, they will make a faint sound when you get close to them and their outline is brighter now
 Changed certain save points to avoid players getting instantly killed when they restart after they have died
 Fix for the blackscreen that was happening to some players after the game's intro


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1151250/Horror_Story_Hallowseed/

notes.title: Horror Story: Hallowseed New Content Update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38082864/c01e92a6ce074f076d501255bd077be48c889e5f.jpg

Greetings everyone!

We have some very exciting news for you today! To start with, we have prepared a new early access content update for Horror Story: Hallowseed that is available right now for you to download and play! This update does more than just bring in new content such as bigger map, or new items, but is basically a complete rework of the previous EA version with re-imagined levels and puzzles.

Important Changes:

 Redesigned forest area
 Completely new and reworked house (3x bigger compared to the previous version with new microscares and puzzles)
 A.I. is much better designed and terrifying
 Ouija board is now complete
 New hints that introduce the story to the player in a better way
 Upgraded visuals
 Improved SFX


Check out this brand new trailer that we have prepared:
[previewyoutube=f_c6EE-mS84;full][/previewyoutube]

For those of you, who would still like to play the previous version of the game, you can do so, by switching over to the "old_story" beta branch in your Steam library. Here are instructions on how to do this:

 Open your Steam client
 Right-click Horror Story: Hallowseed 
 Select the "Properties..." option from the drop-down menu
 Head over to the BETAS tab and select "old_story - Original version of Hallowseed" from the beta selection menu
 After this, let the game update and play the original version of the game


Additionally, to celebrate this milestone, we have prepared a weeklong discount on Steam during which you'll be able to grab the game for 20% off its price!

Lastly, after many many hours of development, testing and polishing the game in order to get its final shape, we are happy to announce that we are aiming to leave Early Access and release the full version on October 28, 2021. Also, as part of this, on Monday, September 27th the price of the game will be permanently increased to 19,99 EUR / USD. So in case you didn't have the chance to get the game yet, now is the best time to do so!

Get Horror Story: Hallowseed right now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1151250/Horror_Story_Hallowseed/

notes.title: Several changes coming in 2021!
notes.notes:
Hello my friends!

I'm working hard, even in these holidays!

2021 Update will bring you guys the new house that will replace the current Farm house.https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1151250/ss_43e5ff826698c4d301a3ef2b770399f3c54a9e69.1920x1080.jpg?t=1608738249

https://twitter.com/HorrorStoryGame/status/1339992323208470530

Edit : The Early Access will not gain any new update before the final release. I promise it will totally worth the wait!

The game would end up with 3h to 4h gameplay, and now it will have 6h.
I'm remaking the whole soundtrack and it will be so scary that you will wish to play the game with your lights on. 
Dozens of events will be replaced,  and many others are being created from scratch, I'll finally add the fixed micro-scares, and you will be able to find not only the 4 bible pages but 7 pages, much more background strory, and new important items that will be needed to face the demon. 
New secret levels and a new variations of demons.
The current demons are dumb and don't get even close to what i'm working on.


To keep following the news everyday or week, follow me on twitter.
https://twitter.com/HorrorStoryGame

Thanks for the support!

Great holidays for all!

Jeff

notes.title: November Friday 13th Update
notes.notes:
Hello my friends!

Made several improvements on the game's optmization for this very early update of November!
It's early because it was  made only 15 days after the Halloween Update and we already have a new Version!
I do not rest haha. 

Also in this new version I started to implement on the Demons/A.I.  logic.
Tey are still not so smart but I promise they are very lesser dumb than what they were.
I'll keep working hard on the A.I. until I have finished this game, so you can wait for a lot of changes that will make them scarier, dangerous and smarter on each new update! 

And, I created a new logic for the Walk/Run input.
Now you will be able to run faster in open places and in large spaces like the Subterrain maze. 
At home and in the Nighmares, you still can't run, but at least accelerate the walk pace. 

And.. that's it for now!

I have plans to release the Final version this year if nothing special happen!
I can't preview the future so...  Let's see what happens!

But one thing I can promise:

I will never give up, I will never abanddon this game, and you will see the final version and all it's great stuff that I created in my mind, but it's yet in development!

Thanks for your support!

Jeff

notes.title: Moving forward to the Final Release!
notes.notes:
Hello my friends! 

Thank you so much for being part of my dream!
It's being a hard work and when I say hard, it's really hard for me to make it all alone, but thank God, I'm alive and fully capable to go on! 
After Halloween Update, the game is now moving forward to the next level... THE FINAL RELEASE! 
It's time for me to look only to the tomorrow and forget about yesterday?  Not at all, I'm fixing some requested things like improving on performance and making the game smoother for more people to play!
I temporarely removed the EPIC option at the graphics settings menu, since it was causing a glitch, where people were playing at high setup, but the game was auto setting some options to EPIC.  Causing video crashings or camera jumps.
I'm still reading players requests for this version until next Monday 9th, then I'll start working on the events for the Final release, and we will only see updates when it comes. 
So, if you see anything weird in the game this weekend, please report it to me, that i'll behappy to fix it as fast as I can! 

So... that's it!

See you soon my friends! 

Let's move to the FINAL RELEEEEEASE!!  hehehe

notes.title: Halloween Update!
notes.notes:
Hello my friends!
I'm happy to announce that, The Halloween Update is coming this October 29th !
I was planing to release it today, but there's some tests to be done and I'm needing to sleep, hehe!

The game now has over 2h of gameplay! (It will have over 3h of gameplay in the final version maybe more than 4h that I hope with my heart, that will be out in December.)

This new version is Introducing the new Micro Scare system.
It means, I removed some old jumpscares to make the game scarier!
Also, adding infrasound system to give a lot of goosebumps heheh

Introducing a new level that completes the basement and starts the revelation!

Now you will get into the story and finally get answers for your questions:
What is happening to his body?
What happened to the familly at the farm house?
*The new level is yet in development, so it will may have several changes by the end of the development. 

Reduced the sequencial events and made it more interactable, means you will have less doors opened by ghosts and more things that will need your interaction!
Removed the stamina process, but kept the slowdown at suffering momments, it's part of the game strategy so... 


I worked on optimization and added a simple graphic settings.
Fixed some collision glitches that was causing the player to almost see across the walls
Fixed the broken save and added a new save point with the new save system.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lkA7Qpoxuq4

Fixed the interaction with doors, so now you will not jumpscare yourself when you click twice.

Well, I think that's it!

I hope you enjoy the new version and Thank you so much for supporting this game!

Happy Halloween!



PS: The Whole game will have several changes by the end of the development, so you will always have something new to see!

notes.title: August Update is here!
notes.notes:
It was a difficult journey for a solo developer, but we came to the August Update!
In this new version, bugs reported by users have been fixed.
1- Global illumination - Fixed
2- Performance - Fixed
3- Teleport Glitch - Fixed
4- Weak flashlight - Fixed

And best of all ... the game time has been increased

Several secret rooms and places have been unlocked!
I improved some jumpscares.
Improved gameplay in the graveyard / nightmare / hell ... (Keeping it secret)
The Ouija board is now active with limited functionality, but fully integrated into the game's events.

Well ... that's it for now!
But this update is not the last one, as I will still be reading your reports and making the necessary improvements until I reach the end of development.


Thanks for the support,

See you!

Jeff

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Hello!
Just updated the game with some bug fixes and improvements.

1- Skylight
Now the GI is a little brighter.
I made this change because some players were complaining that the game is too dark.  Here in my PC it isn't but I increased GI intensity from 0.6 to 0.8.
2 - (Player requested) I changed the Run Input . 
I was at left Alt key and now it's at left Shift.
3 - Freedom to Run*. 
I reduced the speed of running to allow you to run even inside the house. *Of course there's a place that running isn't allowed, it's part of the game.
4 - Made some changes in the reading letters input.

5 - Added some extra point lights to help some players to find the ways...

Well that's it for now, please before you leave a megative review, feel free to write reports at the discussions tab! 
I'll be glad to read all reports there, and try to solve any problem!

Thanks

Jeff
